title: ctaudit / S3 access log report
description: The ctaudit S3 access log HTML report rebuilt from the request and finding lines ctaudit ships to Loki (--loki, or serve s3). Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time; lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time, so the range must then cover the scan runs.

list.name: requester
list.label: Requester (regex)
list.description: Regular expression on the requester (the principal ARN, or "anonymous").

list.name: remote_ip
list.label: Remote IP (regex)
list.description: Regular expression on the remote IP.

panels.title: Requests

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" [$__range]))

panels.description: S3 access log requests in the time range that match the job, bucket, status class, requester, and remote IP filters. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Errors

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json error_code="error_code" | status_class=~"4xx|5xx" or error_code!="" [$__range]))

panels.description: Matching requests with a 4xx or 5xx status class.

panels.title: Denied

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json status="status", error_code="error_code" | status="403" or error_code="AccessDenied" [$__range]))

panels.description: Matching requests with a 403 status.

panels.title: Anonymous

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | requester="anonymous" [$__range]))

panels.description: Matching requests made by an unauthenticated (anonymous) requester.

panels.title: Bytes sent

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json bytes_sent="bytes_sent" | unwrap bytes_sent [$__range]))

panels.description: Total bytes sent by matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Buckets

targets.expr: count(sum by (bucket) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" [$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct buckets that produced matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Requests by status class

targets.expr: sum by (status_class) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: Findings (newest 500 lines)

targets.expr: {job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="finding"}

panels.description: Findings do not carry a bucket or status_class label, so this table ignores those filters. Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the finding's request time; lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time.

panels.title: Operations

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (operation) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json operation="operation" | operation!="" | keep operation [$__range])))

panels.description: S3 operations (REST.GET.OBJECT and similar) with the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Requesters

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (requester) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | requester!="" | keep requester [$__range])))

panels.description: Requesters (principal ARN, or "anonymous") that sent the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top remote IPs

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (remote_ip) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | remote_ip!="" | keep remote_ip [$__range])))

panels.description: Remote IPs that sent the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Denied by remote IP

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (remote_ip) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json status="status" | status="403" | remote_ip!="" | keep remote_ip [$__range])))

panels.description: Remote IPs with the most 403 (denied) responses. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Error codes

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (error_code) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json error_code="error_code" | error_code!="" | keep error_code [$__range])))

panels.description: Non-empty error codes on the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Top keys

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (obj) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json key="key" | key!="" | label_format obj=`{{.bucket}}/{{.key}}` | keep obj [$__range])))

panels.description: Bucket/key pairs (object keys) with the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Bytes sent by requester

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (requester) (sum_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json bytes_sent="bytes_sent" | unwrap bytes_sent [$__range])))

panels.description: Requesters that received the most bytes from matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Bytes sent by remote IP

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (remote_ip) (sum_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json bytes_sent="bytes_sent" | unwrap bytes_sent [$__range])))

panels.description: Remote IPs that received the most bytes from matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Requests by bucket

targets.expr: sum by (bucket) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" [$__range]))

panels.description: Matching requests by bucket, sorted highest first. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: TLS versions

targets.expr: sum by (tls_version) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json tls_version="tls_version" | tls_version!="" | keep tls_version [$__range]))

panels.description: TLS protocol versions negotiated by matching requests, sorted highest first. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Auth types

targets.expr: sum by (auth_type) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json auth_type="auth_type" | auth_type!="" | keep auth_type [$__range]))

panels.description: Authentication types (AuthHeader, QueryString, or empty for anonymous/unsigned) of matching requests, sorted highest first. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Signature versions

targets.expr: sum by (sig_version) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json sig_version="sig_version" | sig_version!="" | keep sig_version [$__range]))

panels.description: SigV2/SigV4 signature versions of matching requests, sorted highest first. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: User agents

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (user_agent) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip" | json user_agent="user_agent" | user_agent!="" | keep user_agent [$__range])))

panels.description: User-Agent headers that sent the most matching requests. Follows the dashboard filters.

panels.title: Requests (newest 500 lines)

targets.expr: {job=~"$job", subcommand="s3", kind="request", bucket=~"$bucket", status_class=~"$status_class"} | json requester="requester", remote_ip="remote_ip" | __error__="" | requester=~"$requester" | remote_ip=~"$remote_ip"

panels.description: Lines shipped with --loki-time event (the serve default) are stored at the request time, so the time range selects requests. Lines shipped with --loki-time scan are stored at the scan time; the real request time is the event_time column.
